newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble firms as T-bill sales near.
newsitem.headline: Rouble firms as T-bill sales near.

text.p: The rouble firmed in calm trading on investor demand ahead of Wednesday's Treasury bill sales, dealers said.

On April 16 the Ministry of Finance will auction 7.5 trillion roubles of 252-day GKO discount Treasury bills (series 22080) and four trillion roubles in an additional 147-day tranche of the series 22076 bills.
roubles/dollar Apr 14 midday Apr 14 early Apr 11 close
"The situation is normal for the beginning of the week, with rouble rates going up ahead of the auctions. Trading is calm otherwise," United Investment Bank chief dealer Alexander Suchkov said.
Another dealer said the rouble could firm further over the evening as banks could open long rouble positions anticipating stronger demand on Tuesday.
